status: Independent scalar audit repair; no timing under this version yet

registration.input: Each existing label/BUILD.json with baseline, source_files SHA256 manifest, wheel, wheel_sha256, and nonempty common build_identity.
registration.build_identity: Must exactly match baseline/candidate: toolchain, release/features/compatibility flags, build environment, target, and lock identity. Driver also directly compares source_files[Cargo.lock]. Root records actual build commands, source before/after checks, and full compatibility test results separately.
registration.environments: Derive label/{np1,np2}/bin/python. Invoke Python -I from evidence directory, remove PYTHONPATH/PYTHONHOME. Verify wrapper and extension imports resolve inside that venv.
registration.installed_bytes: For each gr_tdigest/ and tdigest_rs/ .py/.so member of the registered wheel ZIP, SHA256 must equal the corresponding installed file. Ignore bytecode and metadata timestamps; record module paths and every checked content hash.
registration.dependencies: Actual Python version, platform, NumPy version, and complete installed dependency name/version list must match between arms. Build registration and wheel hashes are checked again after the run.

numpy.policy: np1 driver runs exactness audits only; parent runs focused binding tests and untouched original suite on both. No NumPy1 speed claim from NumPy2 measurements.

timing.calibration: One baseline-only 4-round pilot per cell. Freeze max(4,ceil(60ms/ns-per-op)); identical counts in both arms, cap1e9. Retained batches below50ms are inconclusive.
timing.escalation: One --rounds-scale10 repeat only after complete matching scale1 result has short batches. Same cases, wheel/registration/protocol hashes. Reuse original baseline rounds times10. Preserve both results.
timing.gc: Leave ordinary cyclic GC enabled and report its state; Python input preparation/imports are outside timing.
timing.add_reset: Predecode pool32 initial digest states outside timer, mutate prepared objects inside timer, exact-byte and state checks outside timer for every output. Both arms use identical pool and final short group counts.
timing.other_operations: Time full public API call including adapter dispatch and ordinary intermediate result destruction; final result destruction and exactness check outside timer.
timing.improvement: Every adjacent paired process-median ratio <=0.97, confirmed on fresh held-out cases and unchanged-operation controls. No automatic retention on screening.
timing.regression: Every paired ratio >1.03 is a confirmed per-cell regression; reject general claimed scope. Never average it away.
timing.noise: Either arm max/min process-median ratio >1.10 is inconclusive, as is any retained sub50ms batch.
timing.timeout: 180seconds per worker; failed or timed-out workloads stay incomplete, never treated as a win.

exactness.states: Compare full serialized bytes and selected quantile/CDF/centroid/stat-representing state, preserving IEEE bits including NaNs. No blanket epsilon.
exactness.arrays: Compare full output bits, dtype, shape, OWNDATA/writeable/contiguous/base attributes. Audit resizing, snapshot independence, and absence of digest aliasing. Compare input bytes before/after calls.
exactness.serialization_oracle: Build input fixtures once with the registered baseline wheel. Write exact hex into each immutable case before running baseline/candidate audits or either timing arm. Candidate-generated encodings are not the decode oracle.
exactness.error_precedence: Retain full exception messages; compare exception type and first message line to exclude volatile Polars expression tracing. Only declared invalid states/version pairs or malformed/null/mixed Polars cases may reject; ordinary failures abort.
exactness.polars: Input size means number of serialized rows in a Binary column, not frontend-owned merge fan-in. Audit full output schema and exact reserialized logical states. Include4-column control.
exactness.scalars: Compare actual Python/NumPy scalar type, dtype, raw storage bytes, and IEEE f64 bits. A one-element query scalar is preserved as a scalar; no forced ndarray conversion or loosened tolerance.

screen_strategy: Small representative performance matrix plus broader audit-only validity cases. E13 valid unit states at1000 inputs time versions1/2/3; empty/fractional/delta/wide-pin states audit every version. E14 timing uses v3 rows1/40/256 and4-column control; v1/v2 and malformed cases are exactness gates.
limitations: Single-thread WSL timing does not establish best-in-world or multithread performance.
E11/E12 numerical algorithms are unchanged; exact baseline state/query agreement is required, not a newly claimed accuracy gain.
All targets and control cells must be considered individually; --limit is diagnostic only.
Both NumPy versions must pass installed-wheel binding and untouched original compatibility suites before retention.
Do not edit the candidate after held-out evidence without registering a new independent holdout.
Before-first-measurement harness repairs may archive original protocol and refreeze; never alter a measured protocol in place.
premeasurement_repairs: Root review: malformed v3 kind fixture uses header+mean_size+8-byte weight, with mean_size4 for f32 and8 for f64.
Root review: checksum-then-mixed fixture appends the opposite precision for either source precision.
Independent v2 supports Python float and NumPy floating scalar outputs with actual type, dtype, raw storage bytes and f64 bits.
